definitionZh: : valid CSS伪类代表任何内容成功验证的输入或其他形式元素. 这使得您可以轻松地让有效的字段采用一个外观,帮助用户确认其数据格式化为正确.
sourceDefinition: The :valid CSS pseudo-class represents any input or other form element whose contents validate successfully. This allows you to easily make valid fields adopt an appearance that helps the user confirm that their data is formatted properly.
